== Summary ==
Identified: [[Chris Schoenthal]] (foreground, grey cap and black polo; same clothing as [[:File:2021 World Championship announcements 1.jpg]]), [[Dan Tartaglione]] (center, Players Committee polo), and [[Jared Napolitano]] (right, lilac polo; same clothing as far left in [[:File:2021 World Championship Top 8.jpg]]). Remaining faces unlabeled.
Announcements before the main event. Taken at the [[2021 World Championship]] (the Hyatt Regency Crystal City, Arlington, Virginia, 8–10 October 2021).

* '''Event:''' [[2021 World Championship]]
* '''Camera timestamp:''' 2021:10:08 17:51:50 (EXIF; camera clock not verified)
* '''Date posted:''' 2021-10-19
* '''Photographer:''' [[Brandon Baity]] ("Here are most of the pictures I took during the weekend", forum post 1356914)
* '''Image:''' native forum attachment, 4592×2584 (full size; replaced an earlier 2400 px copy on 22 November 2026).
